name: Meta Ads
description: Programmatically create, manage, and optimize ad campaigns across Meta platforms including Facebook and Instagram using the Marketing API.

evidence.claim: The Marketing API is a collection of Graph API endpoints used to advertise across Meta technologies.
Meta provides an official hosted Model Context Protocol server (Ads MCP Server) for managing ads via AI agents.
Community MCP servers exist for the Meta Marketing API such as pipeboard-co/meta-ads-mcp and byadsco/meta-ads-mcp.

notes: Meta Ads provides extensive REST/Graph APIs for campaign management, insights, and catalogs. It also features official and community-built MCP servers for AI agent connectivity.
